text:
You need someone who can both manage and execute your SEM and Facebook advertising, update the website, build and test landing pages daily, and stay in close communication with the CEO throughout the workday.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data visualization, data cleaning, and working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I’m comfortable working in fast-moving, detail-heavy environments where performance has to be tracked, refined, and communicated clearly. I can help organize campaign data, analyze ad performance, and turn feedback into actionable improvements while staying aligned with your approval process.

I’m also used to working with structured reporting and making decisions based on clean, reliable data. Since this role requires full-time availability and daily collaboration, I’d be glad to support that workflow.

Would you like me to focus first on SEM optimization, landing page testing, or Facebook ads?
